# ProfitPilot
> AI-Driven Retail Management Platform for Indian MSMEs, engineered by Bhvya Vaish.

## Overview
ProfitPilot is a modern cloud application built to empower small business owners across India. It integrates inventory control, GST-compliant invoicing, live business health analytics, tax regime estimators, and a localized AI business assistant.

## Developer
- Name: Bhvya Vaish
- Portfolio / GitHub: https://github.com/bhvyavaish
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhvya-vaish/

## Key Features
- Smart Inventory Tracking & Low Stock Alerts
- GST Billing & Invoicing (English & Hindi)
- Sales Velocity & Capital Efficiency Metrics
- Tax Planning (Section 44AD & Composition Scheme)
- Multi-tenant Firestore & Firebase Authentication
